summary: Restore the missing subject and correct nach sie
before: wenn aber seine Hand nach sie (einer Figur) ausstreckte
after: wenn er aber seine Hand nach ihr (einer Figur) ausstreckte
rationale: The clause needs a subject for ausstreckte: er. The edition itself also omits er, so that omission is inherited rather than independently confirmed by its wording. Its “nach einer Figur” does, however, confirm the object of nach; the entry’s substituted pronoun must be dative ihr, not sie. The parenthetical clarification is retained.

before: einziehen (Arm), hochziehen (wie das Huhn den Fuss);
after: einziehen (Arm), hochziehen (wie das Huhn den Fuss); mit ruḥo: sich zurückziehen, zurückzucken;
rationale: Clarifies the meaning already illustrated by the entry’s sole example: ruḥe is the reflexive whole-person object, not an arm or leg. The inherited wording is retained and the reflexive reading appended.

summary: konazwa has -wa and is Infectum-wa. Its reflexive object ruḥe preserves active syntax; reflexive meaning is not evidence for Detransitive.
The repeated game situations explain habitual bodily signalling; no separate lexical meaning signal or object is established.
The reader’s thin-cell proposal duplicates the entry’s only quotation. The change clarifies its gloss rather than adding the same text.
ruḥe is a reflexive whole-person object: Selim recoils or draws himself back as a signal during the game. This extends the limb-retraction gloss without another numbered sense.
